verdict.rationale: The evidence shows reusable, versioned pipelines that can be deployed to production, plus webhooks that fire when async jobs complete. But every run is still started by an API call. Nothing documents schedules, recurring runs, or event triggers that would let automations run autonomously in the background. These are developer building blocks for constructing automation, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
